verified_key_information_units.information: Liven completed an initial public offering in April-May 2026, raising EUR 4.9 million through the issuance of new shares and listed its shares on the Nasdaq Tallinn Baltic Main List on 15 May 2026. Additionally, EUR 1.36 million in dividends was paid during the period.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Shareholders sections (including details of share price, number of shares, and dividend payment)

candidate_sentences.text: Cash rose to EUR 10.033 million following the IPO, which raised EUR 4.932 million from more than 2,400 investors.
The shares began trading on Nasdaq Tallinn’s Main List in May.

verified_key_information_units.information: During Q2 2026, Liven expanded its Berlin portfolio by acquiring two development properties: Plantagenstraße 19 for EUR 1.7 million and Reichstraße 101 for EUR 1.2 million, planning nearly 20 residential units each with construction scheduled to start at the end of 2027 and the beginning of 2028, respectively.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview section (including total project investment amounts over EUR 11 million and approximately EUR 8 million)

verified_key_information_units.information: Following the reporting period in July 2026, Liven signed a contract to acquire development properties at Pärnu maantee 35, 37, and 41 in Tallinn for EUR 10 million, with plans for over 160 residential and commercial units.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Events after the reporting period section

candidate_sentences.text: New Berlin acquisitions and the post-period acquisition of Tallinn properties at Pärnu maantee 35/37/41 strengthened future growth prospects.

verified_key_information_units.information: Market dynamics in Q2 2026 showed a weekly sales ratio of nearly 3.1%, exceeding the long-term normal range of 1.5–2.0%, with Liven holding over 8% market share in Greater Tallinn during the first six months of 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Overview and Economic environment sections (including supporting factors such as recovering household purchasing power and unified tax-free minimum wage)

candidate_sentences.text: The weekly sales ratio rose to nearly 3.1% at quarter-end, with the quarterly average increasing to approximately 2.4% from 1.5% in the first quarter.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liven's outlook for the remainder of 2026 indicates that nearly 90% of its EUR 59 million revenue target has been secured through realized revenue and contracts, with expectations for increasing revenue and net profit in H2 2026, aiming to exceed the 20% return on equity target.

candidate_sentences.text: Management expects most 2026 handovers, revenue and profit to occur in the fourth quarter and forecasts revenue of EUR 59 million for the year, with nearly 90% already earned or covered by contracts.
